SELECT NOT EXISTS (
            (SELECT position, ingredient_id, sub_recipe_version_id, bakers_pct_x1000
                FROM recipe_line WHERE recipe_version_id = $1
            EXCEPT ALL
            SELECT * FROM unnest($2::int[], $3::bigint[], $4::bigint[], $5::int[]))
            UNION ALL
            (SELECT * FROM unnest($2::int[], $3::bigint[], $4::bigint[], $5::int[])
            EXCEPT ALL
            SELECT position, ingredient_id, sub_recipe_version_id, bakers_pct_x1000
                FROM recipe_line WHERE recipe_version_id = $1)
        ) AS "unchanged!"
